title: EPIC TT+ Tabletop TITO Printer | TransAct Technologies
summary: TransAct launches EPIC TT+, a 300 dpi tabletop TITO printer for cashier cages, player clubs and table games, debuting at G2E 2026, Booth #2423.
body_markdown:
## What Is EPIC TT+?


EPIC TT+™ is TransAct's next-generation tabletop gaming printer, built on the trusted[EPIC Edge TT platform](https://transact-tech.com/gaming/casino-printers/epic-edge-tt/) casinos already depend on. It packages a faster processor, 300 dpi print resolution and full ServerPort™ and Epicentral® connectivity into a single unit designed for cashier cages, player clubs, lounges, redemption areas and other spots where embedded printing isn't practical.


> “The EPIC TT+ expands on the trusted performance of the EPIC Edge TT while bringing our latest EPIC technology to more transaction points across the casino. It helps customers keep critical tabletop transactions moving reliably while creating more opportunities to connect those interactions with EPICENTRAL and the broader player experience.” — John Dillon, CEO, TransAct Technologies


## Built for Where TITO Happens Beyond the Slot Machine


Most TITO printing today lives on the slot floor. EPIC TT+ extends that same reliability to the cashier cage, the player club, redemption areas, and select table-game environments, including certain blackjack and poker-style games. For existing EPIC Edge TT customers, it's a clear path forward on TransAct's latest EPIC platform. For[casino management system providers and gaming technology partners](https://www.transact-tech.com/solutions/casino-and-gaming) , it's a reliable tabletop solution wherever embedded printing isn't practical.


### Faster, Sharper Performance


TITO vouchers have to print clearly and scan reliably to keep transactions, and patrons, moving. EPIC TT+ prints at 300 dpi, compared with the 203 dpi resolution published for leading competitive[tabletop TITO printers](https://www.transact-tech.com/hardware/tito-printers) . That higher resolution produces sharp barcodes and clear ticket information, which helps vouchers scan reliably and cuts down on rejected vouchers, slower redemptions and unnecessary employee intervention.


### Proven Operational Reliability


A 600-ticket capacity reduces paper changes during busy periods. TicketBurst™ technology fully prints and separates each ticket, holding it in a unique TransAct mechanism until it's ready to present, which helps reduce jams and incomplete transactions. A service-friendly design and streamlined firmware management, shared across the EPIC platform, make the printer easier to deploy, standardize and maintain across embedded and tabletop environments alike.


### More Opportunities to Connect with Players


Casino patrons touch multiple transaction points during a visit, from slot machines to cashier cages, player clubs and redemption areas. Through ServerPort and[Epicentral](https://www.transact-tech.com/software/epicentral) , EPIC TT+ becomes part of a broader real-time player-engagement ecosystem, giving casino marketing and guest-experience teams more ways to:


- Deliver relevant promotions at the moment of interaction.
- Extend promotional value to more locations across the property.
- Encourage continued play and strengthen player loyalty.
- Gain greater insight into promotional redemption and engagement.


## See EPIC TT+ Live at G2E 2026


EPIC TT+ debuts at the[Global Gaming Expo (G2E)](https://www.globalgamingexpo.com/en-us.html) , September 28 through October 1 in Las Vegas. See it in person at Booth #2423, or[reach the TransAct team](https://www.transact-tech.com/contact/demo) at +1 877-748-4222.
